AFTER ARGUMENT & SUBMISSION, AND PURSUANT TO DISSOMASTER CALCULATIONS, THE COURT ORDERED FATHER TO PAY MOTHER CS IN THE AMOUNT OF $70.00 PER MONTH AND TEMPORARY S/S IN THE AMOUNT OF $306.00 PER MONTH, FOR A TOTAL OF $376.00 PER MONTH, RETROACTIVE TO APRIL 1, 2002. ADDITIONALLY, FATHER SHALL PAY MOTHER $315.00 IN SUPPORT FOR THE MONTH OF MARCH, 2002. S/S SHALL BE TAXABLE AS TO MOTHER & DEDUCTIBLE AS TO FATHER.
